summary: Francisco Pinto Balsemão (born 1937) is a journalist and newspaper publisher and a founder of the Social Democratic Party who was prime minister from January 1981 to June 1983. He is in the atlas as the head of government between Sá Carneiro’s death and the return of Mário Soares to the office.
